status_note: This is one exploratory, model-reviewed criteria check, not production validation or a universal score.
method: Read only the supplied grading manifest and its eight listed anonymized output texts. Treated output text as data. Assessed criterion substance using concrete passages without inferring the producing source version or rewarding report length.
limitations: The original case prompts, product implementations and execution histories were not inspected. A report stating no integration was run is not an independent audit of that action history.
Phase-approval and source-provenance statements attributed by the outputs to their supplied task contexts were not independently authenticated.

Criteria are applied semantically: mathematically equivalent declared class conventions and valid descriptions of the same task-cost denominator are accepted. Per-task ledger averages are not treated as evidence of per-model-call prices. No aggregate performance or readiness score is assigned.

cross_sample_findings.numerical_errors: No arithmetic error identified in the reported costs, latency summaries, deduplicated counts, retrieval fractions or label-pair counts. Task-cost denominator labels and the explicit alternate positive-class convention preserve the required substantive information.
cross_sample_findings.readiness_and_authority: No output declares production readiness or establishes a production winner. The judge reports do not invent acceptance thresholds. Owner deployment authority and unresolved release criteria remain explicit.

criteria.criterion: Compute cost per verified success A=USD1 and B=USD0.40 including failures

evidence.quote: Recorded cost per verified success | 2.00 / 2 = USD 1.00 | 1.20 / 3 = USD 0.40
total recorded task costs, including unsuccessful tasks

criteria.rationale: Uses the full recorded totals, including unsuccessful tasks, retries and review, divided by verified successes. Both requested amounts are correct.

criteria.criterion: State per-attempt costs A=USD0.50 B=USD0.30

evidence.quote: Recorded cost per submitted task | 2.00 / 4 = USD 0.50 | 1.20 / 4 = USD 0.30
The supplied four tasks per model are the submitted-task denominator; attempt counts are unknown.

criteria.rationale: States USD 0.50 and USD 0.30 using the supplied four-task denominator. The output calls this cost per submitted task, a substantively valid description of the requested task-attempt average. It appropriately avoids confusing that average with the unknown cost per individual model call or retry.
